ops.prevDaySetup: When used as an exhibition or sales event, the fee for setup and preparation time is half of the usage fee (price list revised April 2025). Load-in, load-out, setup and removal are in principle also charged at the normal venue usage fee. Courier deliveries are accepted only on the day before use, only if notified in advance and approved, and the delivered items are not managed by the venue.
ops.loadingHours: Load-in uses the car park building (up to 3.5 m high on the 1F, up to 2.3 m high on the 2F-7F), and goods are carried from the loading parking spaces by the load-in/load-out elevators. A load-in/load-out plan must be submitted in advance to ease congestion. The load-in/load-out elevators are No. 1 and No. 22 (car interior W2,200 x D2,100 x H3,000 mm, door W1,500 x H2,300 mm, capacity 2,300 kg) and No. 2, No. 3 and No. 23 (car interior W2,200 x D2,100 x H2,700 mm, door W1,500 x H2,300 mm, capacity 2,300 kg), all automatic. Carts are prohibited in the passenger elevators (No. 4 to 21). The car park entrance directly connected to the 4F joins the 5F of the car park, with a maximum opening of W2,387 x H2,650 mm. The vehicle entrance is open 7:00-22:00. Bring your own carts, and protect the building and equipment thoroughly.
ops.vehicleRules: At the loading parking spaces, vehicles must leave promptly after unloading or loading. If congested with load-in/load-out vehicles, the organizer places traffic staff; follow the staff's instructions in the car park. The vehicle height limit is 3.5 m on the 1F and 2.3 m on the 2F-7F. If you want to settle parking fees in one lump sum afterwards, you can receive a deferred-payment parking ticket in advance.
ops.parking: 659 spaces. Standard cars 300 yen per 30 min, large vehicles 450 yen per 30 min. The vehicle height limit is 3.5 m on the 1F and 2.3 m on the 2F-7F.
ops.catering: Eating or drinking inside the venue requires prior approval from the company. For catering, use the company's designated vendors; bringing in food or drink from outside is in principle not accepted. The same applies to the conference rooms: bringing in food or drink from anywhere other than TOC partner shops is prohibited. Gas cylinders (propane gas) cannot be brought in.
ops.restaurants: In-building facilities are a restaurant floor on the 3F, and a 7-Eleven and a Doutor Coffee Shop on the 2F.
